Owner.guideText: Complete information helps seekers find their business space.

subtitles.form: Complete the property information so seekers can understand it more easily.
subtitles.listings: Monitor your properties and next steps in one place.
subtitles.applications: Review tenant profiles, offers, and documents.
subtitles.surveys: Manage visits and coordinate schedules with potential tenants.
subtitles.messages: Connect directly with seekers interested in your property.

form.saveHint: Save as a draft or publish. Valid location, rent, and area inputs are used for automatic analysis.
form.name: Property name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe your property's advantages and condition.
form.analysisHint: Enter the actual annual rent, building area, and coordinates. Analysis is saved automatically, including for drafts within model coverage. Environmental factors use reference data; you do not need to guess scores.
form.coordinatesHint: Select a point on the map to fill coordinates automatically. Place the pin on the property. Analysis coverage extends 10 km from Semarang reference points.
form.facilitiesHint: Provide actual electrical capacity, water source, and parking capacity. Separate additional facilities with commas. This information helps seekers assess operating requirements.
form.mapTitle: Choose the property location on the map
form.mapHint: Click the map to place a pin, or drag the pin to the property. You can also pan with arrow keys and press Enter to select the map centre.
form.mapError: The map could not fully load. Check your connection or enter coordinates manually.
form.mapEmpty: No point selected. Choose the property location on the map.
form.mapSimpleHint: Search an address, choose a result, then drag the pin onto the property. Coordinates fill automatically.
form.mapNoResults: No places found. Try a street or district name, or select directly on the map.
form.mapSelectHint: Click the map or use the centre button to choose a location.
form.mapSearchShort: Enter at least 3 characters to search.
form.mapSearchError: Search is unavailable. Try again or select directly on the map.
form.mapLocationError: Device location is unavailable. Allow location access in your browser or select directly on the map.
form.mapZoomHint: Use + / −, drag the slider, or scroll gently over the map. On mobile, pinch with two fingers to zoom.
